newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro TV commercial market seen at 16.4 bln francs.
newsitem.headline: Euro TV commercial market seen at 16.4 bln francs.

text.p: Seven hundred and sixty people watch television in Europe and the television commercial market is worth 16.4 billion francs per year, according to specialised TV ad intermediary IP.

Its Televion 96 study presented at the Mipcom industry fair here shows there are 59 broadcasters with 400 channels, producing 2.5 million hours of programmes and 40 million commercials, said IP marketing director Thierry Tacheny.
